lines.text: Farming Simulator is a game where you wake up...
Which sounds suspiciously similar to the thing video games were invented to help us escape from.
Most of the time, your greatest enemy...
is a field that's slightly larger than you expected.
And yet millions of people voluntarily spend their evenings
and getting genuinely excited about buying a bigger tractor.
